title.narrative: Establishing a residential complex for internally displaced persons with public service facilities in Hajjah Governorate

description.narrative: Completion of the construction of 232 affordable homes. Completion of the construction of a secondary school.

Construction of (232) economic housing units for internally displaced persons, each housing unit will contain two rooms, a bathroom, a kitchen, and an open courtyard. A secondary school will also be built.

Providing (232) affordable housing units for the displaced in the northwestern regions of Hajjah Governorate, Midi District. A secondary school will also be constructed to meet the educational needs of the children of the complex residents and the host community residents.
